files.summary: replace the obsolete proximity-save upgrade claim with current contact validation and lifecycle
edits: Current-format saves retain admitted sense definitions, exact definition dependencies and valid body-contact episodes. The current manifest validator rejects unsupported proximity-detector implementations; it does not upgrade older saves. Follow the [development save policy](../AGENTS.md#development-save-policy), without adding a compatibility reader or automatically resetting a world. During supported live changes, losing or disabling the detector clears its active contacts without fabricating a perceived ending; a replacement detector cannot inherit another detector’s episode. Historical experiences remain historical evidence, not proof of present contact.
